review.shorterRoute: Inspecting the existing Gamma1 modular-curve proof suggests reusing that curve family. Before expansion, link its exact level Q*N^2 to the actual principal kernel and orbit stabilizers by an integral diagonal transition. Reuse the existing lower_div_tau_det_eq_one calculation and native Gamma1/conjGL definitions. No new general congruence-curve theory is needed for this group link. The existing sourceRaisedLevelConjugation and its injectivity supply the actual Gamma1 homomorphism by restriction; no new choice-based group homomorphism is developed. At this stage the native finite-index coinduction counit is necessary: faithful restriction proves it epi, and the existing Gamma0 H1 surjection proves the actual H1 transfer onto. Existing Shapiro and group-isomorphism reindexing then identify the source with constant-coefficient Gamma1 H1.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: The exact Gamma1(Q*N^2) group maps injectively into the original Gamma0(Q), has finite-index image, and fixes the actual binary vectors modulo N. The native finite-index coinduction counit is surjective on original H1 when six is invertible. Shapiro, the actual trivial coefficient isomorphism and existing group reindexing identify its source with constant-coefficient H1 of that exact Gamma1 group. Hence every original integral binary H1 class modulo every positive power of every prime greater than three has a derived constant-coefficient Gamma1 realization. The actual coefficient-orbit stabilizers are also dominated by the same explicit Gamma1 cover.
review.remaining: The constant-coefficient Gamma1 transfer has not yet been identified with arithmetic geometric correspondences or shown to intertwine the required Gamma1 Hecke-and-diamond operators. Those geometric/Hecke comparisons, original all-weight adic association, local/image/regularity, automorphy and higher continuation remain open. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
